To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the most important thing for university students to learn about leadership is how to lead, (2) the most important things for university students to know about leading in urban schools is what it is like to work in urban schools and how to make a difference, and (3) the most important way for university students to make a difference in urban school is to work directly in urban schools.
the most significant factor in improving urban schools is the quality of the leadership of the principal.
